Invoices.connecting_a_tenant: How to set up the Telegram Bot?
Invoices.connect_step_1: Search for @BotFather in Telegram and send "/newbot" to generate your Bot Agent.
Invoices.connect_step_2: Set the token as TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in your server's environment variables (see .env.example).
Invoices.connect_step_3: Ask tenants to find their unique Chat ID via @CheckMyIDBot and save it onto their profile page.
